Jaisalmer storm damages solar panels, kills elderly man, injures grandchildren

A severe storm with strong winds and rain hit Jaisalmer, causing damage to solar panels. The incident resulted in the death of an elderly man and injuries to his grandchildren. The injured children were referred to Jodhpur for further medical attention.
